# Symbiote UI

> Agent-ready Web Components, layouts, themes, manifests, and UI contracts for professional Symbiote interfaces. No build step.

Symbiote UI lets agents and host apps assemble dense professional interfaces from reusable Web Components, layout shells, graph editors, chat surfaces, source/code panels, data displays, menus, controls, and Cascade themes. Use the published package exports and provider metadata instead of importing implementation paths or cloning host-product UI.

## Key resources

- [README](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/README.md): package overview, quick start, features, entry points, and related projects
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history and current unreleased changes
- [custom-elements.json](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/custom-elements.json): full Web Component catalog with properties, attributes, events, and theme aliases
- [discover.js](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/discover.js): provider discovery command used by agents and build tooling

- [project-transaction-v1](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/schemas/project-transaction-v1.json): project graph transaction metadata

## Component and layout guidance

- Use `symbiote-ui/ui` for browser Web Components and shared UI modules.
- Use `symbiote-ui/layout` for layout shells, routers, sidebars, project tabs, panel menus, and region orchestration.
- Use `symbiote-ui/canvas` or `symbiote-ui/graph` for graph explorers, node canvases, structured/flat graph modes, graph metadata, and transactions.
- Use `symbiote-ui/chat` for chat composers, transcripts, message lists, sidebars, and message models.
- Use `symbiote-ui/display` for source viewers/editors, code blocks, data tables, metrics, banners, event feeds, and output previews.
- Use `symbiote-ui/themes`, `symbiote-ui/tokens`, and `symbiote-ui/manifest` for Cascade theme metadata, aliases, and provider catalogs.

## Graph explorer guidance

Register `graph-explorer-shell`, `node-canvas`, `canvas-graph`, and `graph-node` when building graph editing or project graph interfaces. Use `createGraphViewModeController` from `symbiote-ui/ui` or `symbiote-ui/canvas` to switch structured and flat renderer visibility, fit/focus state, path style, and host-owned flat graph models. Use `flatNodeIds` when fitting several `canvas-graph` nodes in flat mode; `flatNodeId` is single-node focus and can enter a hierarchical parent group. `canvas-graph` reads `--sn-canvas-graph-*` and `--sn-graph-type-*` aliases from the Cascade theme, so host apps should pass semantic node types instead of local canvas color constants.
